description: Every unary partial recursive function \(f\) has a primitive-recursive Boolean certificate test \(T_f(x,w)\) such that \(f(x)\simeq U(\mu w\,[T_f(x,w)])\); its graph is existence of an accepted certificate with the specified extracted output, and all certificates at one input have that same output.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.normal_form (f : ℕ → Part ℕ)
  (hf : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive fun v => f (List.Vector.get v 0)) :
  ∃ T,
    Primrec₂ T ∧
      (∀ (x y : ℕ),
          y ∈ f x ↔ ∃ w, T x w = true ∧ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract w = y) ∧
        (∀ (x : ℕ),
            f x =
              Part.map Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract
                (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.searchTest T x)) ∧
          ∀ (x u v : ℕ),
            T x u = true →
              T x v = true →
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract u =
                  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.extract v
